biotools.summary: JAMMA (Highly-Accelerated Multi-method Mixed-Model Association) is an open-source Python and C implementation of GEMMA's core linear mixed-model workflows for genome-wide association studies (GWAS). It reads PLINK binary genotypes and supports kinship estimation, Wald, likelihood-ratio and score association tests, covariates, multiple phenotypes, and leave-one-chromosome-out (LOCO) analysis. JAMMA provides a command-line interface with familiar GEMMA flags, GEMMA-compatible association output, and a Python API. Native C kernels, parallel computation and reusable eigendecompositions support large analyses. Pre-flight memory checks and streamed output help manage memory use. Numerical validation against GEMMA is documented. JAMMA runs on Linux, macOS and Windows; large-cohort analyses require sufficient RAM and a suitable 64-bit BLAS configuration. Released under GPL-3.0-or-later.

documentation.note: Numerical validation against GEMMA, including comparison tolerances.

function.note: Linear mixed-model association testing with PLINK .bed/.bim/.fam genotypes, phenotype data, and optional covariates and kinship matrix. Outputs GEMMA-compatible .assoc.txt tables containing effect estimates and test statistics. Supports Wald, likelihood-ratio and score tests, multiple phenotypes, and LOCO analysis.
